title: File:Street and canal at dusk, Oudezijds Voorburgwal 'blue hour', 7 januari 2011 (5821465439).jpg
desc:
Amsterdam was founded around 1250 with the building of the Dam that gave it its name. ‘Aeme Stelle Redamme’ is Medieval Dutch for: ‘Dam in a Watery Area’.
The Dam is still here and still functions as the heart of the city. But today this former barrier between the River Amstel and the “Southern Sea”
